title: Narakumi
body:
Syntax: perform narakumi <target>

Description: A Genjutsu jutsu, unlocked at level 15. 24-29 mental damage, with a 50% chance to inflict Narakumi for 24 seconds, dulling the target's reflexes and lowering their chance to land hits. Costs 22 Chakra, 4 second cooldown. Active Sharingan resistance shortens the effect.

Date: 2026-08-22
